### Observed differences

- A01 was not observed in any of the 200 earlier traces; in the later window it occurs in all 200 traces, exactly once per trace, always at the same relative position (about halfway through the case). [OCC001, POS001]
- Earlier, every observed outgoing transition of A07 went to A04; in the later window every such transition goes to A01 instead, and all of A01's outgoing transitions go to A04. [DIR002, DIR001]
- The distance from A07 to A04 grew: in the earlier window A04 immediately followed A07 in all 200 traces, while in the later window exactly one activity lies between them in all 200 traces. [LAG001]
- In the earlier window, A04 and A07 each occurred without A01 in every trace; in the later window A01 co-occurs with both, always after A07 and always before A04 (200 of 200 traces in each case). [REL001, REL002]
- Relative positions shifted consistently with one step inserted between A07 and A04: A07's mean relative position moved from 0.40 to 0.33, A04's from 0.60 to 0.67, with A01 sitting between them at 0.50. [POS003, POS002, POS001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that in the later window a step A01 is executed between A07 and A04 in every case: earlier A07 was followed immediately by A04, whereas later A07 leads to A01 and A01 leads to A04, with A01 running exactly once per trace after not being observed at all in the earlier window. [DIR001, DIR002, REL001, REL002, LAG001, OCC001]

The support is direct and consistent: the successor of A07 changed from A04 to A01 and A01's successor is A04; the fixed order A07 before A01 before A04 holds in all 200 later traces; the A07–A04 gap widened from one to two steps; and A01's participation rose from 0 to 200 of 200 traces. All nine qualifying control-flow items describe this one difference, far more than the roughly 0.04 items expected by chance if nothing had changed, and each difference exceeds about 995 in 1,000 random re-splits of the pooled data. [DIR001, DIR002, REL001, REL002, LAG001, OCC001, POS001, POS002, POS003]

A competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out is that A01 events also occurred earlier but were not recorded, so the difference would lie in logging rather than in execution; the finite windows also leave some margin for sampling variation, although 0 versus 200 of 200 traces leaves little room for it. [OCC001, POS001]
